run_book_coordinator: run the BookCoordinator to orchestrate automated book formalization with parallel agent execution and review loops
clean_book_coordinator: clean previous run data and reset the BookCoordinator to start a fresh formalization from scratch
load_manifest_chapters: load chapters from a manifest JSON file into the BookCoordinator state for processing
launch_provers_for_sorries: launch prover agents to prove theorems with sorry placeholders in Lean files
scan_lean_sorries: scan a Lean file to find theorem and lemma declarations that contain sorry proofs
